description: Search active private-seller car listings on AutoPrivado. Filters: free text (make/model), make, model, market country, price range with currency, max km, min year, fuel. A country search also returns cars cross-listed into that market (crossListed, marketPrice, marketCurrency); price filters use that market's currency (PLN in PL, EUR elsewhere). Results may be up to a minute old.

currency.description: Only listings priced in this currency (in the searched market)
